decision.rationale: The user response omits email_address after name-only creation. Optional storage and NON_NULL serialization explain it, but tests do not assert this response-field absence; intended requiredness remains unsupported.

scope.tests_and_docs: Package-local test directories, README/API prose and linked DTO/service/serialization files only.

manual_fallback.notes: UsersIntegrationTest creates a user without email and checks status/name/id, not serialized email absence. UserDaoTest:94 tests a populated email on update; this is not the empty-email creation scenario. NON_NULL and optional storage are context only.

coverage_resolution: Manual handler and field review supplements the lexical scan.
